title: Tidewatch launch film

shots.visual: generated clip: dawn on a rocky shore, tide far out, a small boat tilted on the mud, gulls; slow push-in, grey-blue light, no people
shots.caption: The tide doesn't wait. Out here, there's no signal.

shots.visual: the same shore, softened; a phone in the middle of the frame, the Tidewatch splash draws its wave mark and wordmark, then the station list appears
shots.caption: Meet Tidewatch.

shots.visual: screen recording of the app, phone on the right over the softened shore: a tap on Harbor Point, the tide curve draws, a marker lands on now, the next high water reads 7:48 AM
shots.caption: Tide tables in your pocket. No signal required.

shots.visual: same phone: the status bar flips to No service, a green Offline badge slides in, the Harbor Point data pack card rises
shots.caption: Works fully offline, with two years of tide data built in

shots.visual: the price sheet slides up: Unlock every station, $4.99 one-time purchase, ticks for no account and no ads; the Unlock button is tapped and turns green
shots.caption: $4.99 one-time purchase

shots.visual: generated clip: a skipper's hands tie off a dinghy as shallow water floods back in around the boots, low warm sun, shallow depth of field; no phone
shots.caption: No accounts to make. No ads to skip.

shots.visual: the same dinghy footage softens as the phone returns with the finished Tidewatch splash; the closing line shows as a caption
shots.caption: Tidewatch. Know the water.
